card.name: Inside the word interleukin
card.fires_on: The final piece "in" of "interleukin", just before a hyphen and a number such as -2 or -6. Weaker on a few other partway-through-word spots in general text.

modes.label: interleukin before number
modes.description: The "in" ending interleukin, right before -1, -2 or -6.

modes.label: Other split words
modes.description: Scattered mid-word pieces in non-medical text, such as names and plural nouns.

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens show no clear link, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It lights up on the last letters of the word interleukin when a number like 2 or 6 comes next.
